issue_context.title: autoid cache 1 impact the row id allocation performance
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

When I'm testing the performance of https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/38442

[autoid.txt](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/files/10129197/autoid.txt)


I use this table schema:

```
create table test (id int unsigned key nonclustered auto_increment) shard_row_id_bits=4 auto_id_cache 1;
```

It avoids the sequent rowid caused tikv hotspot issue.
But I find the flamegraph abnormal:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1420062/204965970-742f4cf7-0a11-49d0-9edc-bf11c2141f20.png)

Row ID allocating takes too much resource!
I figure out that cause by the side effect of the auto_id_cache = 1 setting.
